name: Enter Air S.A.
summary: Enter Air S.A. operates as a charter airline company in Europe. The company offers production planning, technical documentation and records, material logistics, and compliance and security, and professional aircraft maintenance and services. In addition, the company provides advertising services, comprising inflight sales magazine; advertising on the outside of the plane; logo on tables, catering carts, and headrests; on-board announcement; and leaflets in the seat pocket. It also offers charter and ACMI services, special services in the field of non-destructive testing and borescope inspections, and offers tool and equipment rental.
